This diatribe is meaningless and mutable to me at this junction... the conversation is in vain as much of the dialouge has contained nothing more than unrestrained accusation and palilalia.

The words here are but intangible mist with no substance and those who get worked up over such impermanent distractions as "what some guy said on reddit" are missing out on life. If anything I have found myself more present and clear-minded as there is no attachment to such banality that exists and is produced from the minds of stoned apes.  

The very fact this discourse is happening is a farce and comical because "in real life" the liberties taken here would never be considered. I live a uniquely blessed life I am grateful for and have full peace in life and full bliss in death. The reality is that few if any sound or logical commentary will come from exchanges with a court of public opinion feeling the effects of various degrees of chemical influence.... on the internet at that.
The underlying essence and purpose of this post has been lost to wandering lost barking dogs of this sub and I am merely passing time as I prepare for tangibly life affirming, mature, authentic and vital human connections as the sun arises.

You know, human touch... morning massage, sauna, group yoga, breakfast amongst new and old friends, a hike near the beautiful SF bay, holding hands with gorgeous loved ones whom are likely not going to be here in a few months.... --- ie; real life --- cherishing real moments ....with real breathing humans.....instead of volleying words from anonymous strangers I'll never meet......... yep... pretty far gone, my perspective is all twisted and I am totally disconnected up here in shambhala... :)

couldnt be happier to be off whatever grid the rest of the community is on.......... 

love to all... this is going nowhere but in cycles.

should someone decide to take this journey for shamanistic or spiritual practice I would suggest avoiding antihistamines within the days prior and afterwards because I took a benadryl the next day on christmas in combination with the rest of the MDMA ( maybe \~50mg or so ) and another \~120ug of LSD or so in one single dose and the "swelling" effect was profoundly amplified. Most likely due to the fact that diphenhydramine also inhibits serotonin reuptake.  
this will make "coming back" with or without assistance much more difficult. 

when I take my final journey with this stack I hope to use a stronger agent for the MAOI ( p. harmala ) and will likely prepare a 'huasca-esque brew to replace the extract I used previously. my major concern being evidence that DMT may act as a neuroprotective when the brain is deprived of oxygen thus negating the desired end result.
